extraction_notes: Fallback to the 2024 report: the system's 2025 EAR upload is only the one-page CCR certification form (the 2025 CCR was emailed to members on 2026-03-17 and is not posted online). Data year taken as 2024 from the title ('2024 Consumer Confidence Report', report date June 3, 2025, samples dated 10/23/2024) although the 'About This Report' sentence still says 'January 1 to December 31, 2022' (template leftover). Results are given per well inside single cells; one entry per well with source_group 'Well 01'/'Well 02'. Table 7 lists no violation, but the RTCR section discloses that one Level 1 assessment was required and completed during the year, with one corrective action required and completed, and zero Level 2 assessments; the RTCR placeholder text '[Enter Additional Information...]' is left unfilled. No secondary-standard or radiological tables are included.
